title: A pair in every causal class
promptMarkdown: Using metres for $ct$ and $x$, classify the displacement vectors $A=(5,3)$, $B=(3,5)$ and $C=(4,4)$ from the origin. For each, determine whether a finite subluminal boost can make its spatial separation zero or its time separation zero, and calculate the required boost when it exists. Prove which time orders are invariant for future-oriented observers.
hintLadder: Set one transformed coordinate to zero and solve for $\beta$.
Check whether the candidate boost lies strictly between -1 and 1.

criteria.criterion: All classifications and boosts are correct.
